versions.changelog:
AgentMemory 0.1.0 — initial release

- Adds persistent SQLite-based memory for Hermes/OpenClaw with structured Authority Lanes (identity, preference, evidence, authorization, procedural).
- Separates raw recall snippets from semantic facts for safer, organized storage.
- Enables lightweight entity/relation tracking and bounded, relation-aware memory recall.
- Features read-only provenance, conflict detection and explicit resolution on critical memory lanes.
- Introduces rebound-protection, sliding TTL, per-lane source restrictions, and automated cleanup support.
- Includes Python API and CLI for adding, recalling, and auditing stored memory items.
